packages.title: Shimla & Manali Tour
packages.description: Skies are clear after the monsoon, the hills are green and the apple season is on. The classic Himachal circuit, planned by road from Delhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.description: Morning departure by cab (about 7 to 8 hours). Evening walk on the Ridge and Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali
itinerary.description: Quick stop at Kufri, then the scenic drive to Manali along the Beas river.

itinerary.title: Manali sightseeing
itinerary.description: Hadimba Temple, Vashisht hot springs, Old Manali cafes and Mall Road. Solang Valley if time allows.

itinerary.title: Manali to Delhi
itinerary.description: Early departure with an overnight return, reaching Delhi late at night.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.description: Morning drive from Delhi to Shimla. Evening leisure walk on the historic Mall Road and Christ Church.

itinerary.title: Shimla & Kufri Excursion
itinerary.description: Visit Kufri fun campus, Himalayan Nature Park, Jakhoo Temple, and scenic viewpoint at the Ridge.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali via Kullu
itinerary.description: Travel along picturesque river valleys with stops at Sundernagar Lake, Pandoh Dam, and river rafting in Kullu.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Manali Local
itinerary.description: Thrilling day at Solang Valley for adventure activities, followed by Hadimba Temple and Tibetan Monastery.

itinerary.title: Manali to Delhi Drop
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to the serene mountains and drive back to Delhi with unforgettable memories.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.description: Comfortable road journey from Delhi to Shimla. Evening stroll around Lakkar Bazaar and Scandal Point.

itinerary.title: Shimla Local & Kufri Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Explore Kufri snow viewpoint, Green Valley, Vice Regal Lodge, and evening at the Ridge.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali Scenic Drive
itinerary.description: Drive through Pandoh Dam, Hanogi Mata Temple, and Shawl weaving centers in Kullu.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing & Cafes
itinerary.description: Visit Hadimba Devi Temple, Vashisht Hot Sulphur Springs, Manu Temple, and Old Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel / Sissu
itinerary.description: Exciting tour to Solang Valley and cross the iconic Atal Tunnel to visit the scenic Sissu waterfall.

itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol & Delhi Return
itinerary.description: Visit Parvati Valley, Kasol, and Manikaran Gurudwara before heading back to Delhi.

packages.title: Jammu & Kashmir Adventure
packages.description: Autumn light on the chinar trees, crisp air and clear mountain views. Trips start and end at Srinagar. Flights or trains to reach Kashmir can be arranged on request.

itinerary.title: Arrive Srinagar
itinerary.description: Pickup and transfer to your hotel. Shikara ride on Dal Lake and the Mughal Gardens at sunset.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg day trip
itinerary.description: Drive to Gulmarg (about 2 hours), Gondola ride and meadow walks. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam (about 3 hours). Betaab Valley and Aru Valley on the way.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Return to Srinagar and drop at the airport or railway station.

itinerary.title: Arrive Srinagar
itinerary.description: Pickup, hotel check-in, Shikara ride on Dal Lake and the Mughal Gardens.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg day trip
itinerary.description: Gondola ride and meadow walks at Gulmarg. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam with stops at Awantipora ruins and saffron fields.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Betaab Valley, Aru Valley and Chandanwari, then back to Srinagar for shawl and dry fruit shopping.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Drop at Srinagar airport or railway station.

itinerary.title: Arrive Srinagar
itinerary.description: Pickup, hotel check-in, Shikara ride on Dal Lake and the Mughal Gardens.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg day trip
itinerary.description: Gondola ride and meadow walks at Gulmarg. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Sonamarg day trip
itinerary.description: Drive along the Sindh river to Sonamarg (about 2.5 hours) and Thajiwas Glacier. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam, stopping at Awantipora ruins on the way.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Betaab Valley, Aru Valley and Chandanwari, then back to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Drop at Srinagar airport or railway station.

packages.title: Rajasthan Heritage Tour
packages.description: Discover grand royal palaces, invincible hilltop forts, desert safaris, and the colorful vibrant culture of Rajasthan.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Jaipur (Pink City)
itinerary.description: Pick up from airport/railway station. Visit Birla Temple, Albert Hall Museum, and explore colorful local bazaars.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Forts & Palaces
itinerary.description: Full day tour: majestic Amber Fort, Jal Mahal photo stop, City Palace, and the iconic Hawa Mahal.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Khatu Shyam & Salasar Balaji
itinerary.description: Spiritual day trip to the revered Khatu Shyam Ji temple and Salasar Balaji Dham.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Departure
itinerary.description: Last minute shopping for authentic handicrafts and textiles before drop at airport or railway station.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Udaipur (City of Lakes)
itinerary.description: Arrive in Udaipur, check in and enjoy a relaxing sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola with view of Jag Mandir.

itinerary.title: Udaipur City Palace & Saheliyon-ki-Bari
itinerary.description: Tour the grand City Palace, Jagdish Temple, Saheliyon-ki-Bari gardens, and Bagore Ki Haveli folk dance.

itinerary.title: Udaipur to Kumbhalgarh Fort
itinerary.description: Excursion to the legendary Kumbhalgarh Fort boasting the world's second-longest continuous wall.

itinerary.title: Udaipur to Chittorgarh Fort
itinerary.description: Day trip to the historic Chittorgarh Fort, Vijay Stambha, and Rani Padmini Palace.

itinerary.title: Departure from Udaipur
itinerary.description: Morning leisure by Fateh Sagar Lake and transfer to Udaipur Airport / Railway station.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jodhpur (Blue City)
itinerary.description: Arrive in Jodhpur. Visit the imposing Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada, and Umaid Bhawan Palace museum.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur to Jaisalmer (Golden City)
itinerary.description: Scenic highway drive to Jaisalmer across the Thar Desert. Evening visit to Gadisar Lake.

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Fort & Patwon Ki Haveli
itinerary.description: Explore the living Golden Fort (Sonar Qila), Salim Singh Ki Haveli, and intricately carved Jain temples.

itinerary.title: Sam Sand Dunes & Desert Camp Stay
itinerary.description: Drive to Sam Sand Dunes. Experience thrilling camel safari, desert jeep safari, Rajasthani folk music, and camp under the stars.

itinerary.title: Kuldhara Ghost Village & Jodhpur Return
itinerary.description: Visit the haunted ruins of Kuldhara village and return to Jodhpur for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur Departure
itinerary.description: Check out and drop at Jodhpur Airport / Railway station with unforgettable desert memories.

packages.title: Uttarakhand Nature Trip
packages.description: Explore serene mountains, rushing rivers, wildlife safaris, and spiritual retreats across the divine Himalayas.

itinerary.title: Haridwar / Rishikesh to Chopta
itinerary.description: Scenic drive through Devprayag (confluence of Alaknanda & Bhagirathi) to Chopta, the 'Mini Switzerland of India'.

itinerary.title: Tungnath & Chandrashila Peak Trek
itinerary.description: Trek to Tungnath (world highest Shiva temple) and summit Chandrashila for 360-degree Himalayan views.

itinerary.title: Chopta to Joshimath
itinerary.description: Picturesque drive to Joshimath via Ukhimath and Chamoli along the Alaknanda valley.

itinerary.title: Joshimath to Auli Snow Excursion
itinerary.description: Take Asia longest ropeway to Auli skiing meadows, artificial lake, and view of Nanda Devi peak.

itinerary.title: Joshimath to Haridwar / Rishikesh Drop
itinerary.description: Return drive with drop at Haridwar / Rishikesh railway station or bus terminal.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Mussoorie
itinerary.description: Morning drive to Queen of Hills, Mussoorie. Evening walk on Mall Road and Camel Back Road.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Kempty Falls, Gun Hill ropeway, Company Garden, and George Everest House.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie to Rishikesh / Haridwar
itinerary.description: Drive down to Rishikesh. Visit Ram Jhula, Laxman Jhula, and attend Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat.

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Jim Corbett National Park
itinerary.description: Drive to Jim Corbett. Check-in to forest resort and enjoy evening nature walk along Kosi River.

itinerary.title: Corbett Jungle Safari to Nainital
itinerary.description: Early morning 4x4 Jeep Safari inside Corbett National Park, then scenic drive up to Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital Lake Tour & Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Boating on Naini Lake, visit Naina Devi Temple, Snow View Point, and Bhimtal / Sattal lakes.

itinerary.title: Nainital to Delhi Drop
itinerary.description: Drive back to Delhi with unforgettable memories of Uttarakhand.

reviews.name: Dr. Rohit & Neha Verma
reviews.comment: Namoh Tourism made our Kashmir honeymoon truly special. Dal Lake houseboat was cozy and Gulmarg snow views were incredible. The driver Farooq was courteous and punctual throughout. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Vikramaditya Singhania & Family
reviews.comment: Traveled with elderly parents. The hotel in Manali had amazing river view and private cab was clean. Had some traffic near Solang valley, but the driver managed the route calmly. Overall good arrangements.

reviews.name: Pooja & Ankit Deshmukh
reviews.comment: Superb arrangements in Jaipur & Udaipur. The palace hotel booking and private Innova cab were top notch. Transparent pricing with zero hidden charges. Will definitely book our next trip with Namoh!

reviews.name: Sunita & Rajesh Aggarwal
reviews.comment: Very well organized trip to Nainital and Jim Corbett. The hotel view was scenic, food was fresh and driver was very skilled in mountain roads. Hotel check-in had slight delay on weekend, but team handled it well.

footer.description: Your trusted travel partner for unforgettable journeys.
